summary: Protected PR #1011 adds this scoped terminal stdio source witness; it does not establish a complete population or native acceptance. At the existing held ordinal-six Python readback, the test follows the actual Process stdin StreamWriter and distinct stdout/stderr StreamReaders. Their retained stream fields join the exact request-wrapper and response-observer targets and separate stderr stream; the pending diagnostic task is the stderr reader async-read task, while the existing callback read/task/state/backing joins remain pending. The closed field set selects byteBuffer and charBuffer on each adapter: stdin has an absent optional byte buffer and 4,096 character elements; stdout and stderr each have a 4,096-byte array and 4,097 character elements. These are five distinct arrays across six fields, disjoint from the eleven selected terminal backings, one callback-read backing and twenty-six request/capture arrays. Character counts are not byte capacities, and diagnostic storage is not a protocol subtotal. Observing the absent writer buffer does not populate it or establish absence of other encoding allocations. Identity checks use the actual retained fields; no initial-allocation identity or replacement history is asserted. Fixed fields, concrete types, endpoint joins and capacities are assertions; changed or unavailable structure fails. The README identifies the initial local runtime as .NET 10.0.12. Qualification records each actual loaded framework/runtime version, core and Process assembly informational versions and module identities; an SDK pin or public runtime tag does not establish those loaded bytes. Only the observed .NET 10 field shape is covered. Inspection performs no extra read, flush, encoding or GC; existing diagnostic and callback owners continue, references stay local and output retains scalar roles/counts/runtime metadata. Existing terminal correlation, resampling, exact slots, ACKs, observation clearing and joined cleanup remain required. This scoped terminal extension does not combine the earlier ACK/child-read cut with terminal observations or establish complete physical population, reclamation or fit. Closed-profile admission remains refused; installed custody, native ACK authentication and original-operation replay/effects remain held.
title: Terminal stdio adapter fields expose scoped protocol and diagnostic buffers on the observed .NET 10 runtime
